### L1 review (#34809) · 2026-11-18T00:04Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 1a6abb30ddcf659a7b7f4dca23115384bbcd4a6d

Tier H (`docs/adr/**`, 1 file, +34 / −1; `check-governed-merges --branch` reads GOVERNED, landing tier H). This verdict does not ready the PR. It goes to the seat's L2 and then to os-zhuang.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### What I checked
Each bullet of the note, against the code at this head:
- **Settled before any row, dry run included.** `admin-import-users.ts#runAdminImportUsers` calls `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` before `runImport`, with no `dryRun` branch ahead of it. `admin-user-endpoints.ts:1056-1092` answers `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION` (Create User's sentence) or `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` when there is no seam or no `addMember`. Its docblock names "single-org, a degraded wall" as joining nothing, which matches the note's last bullet.
- **One unit of work per created row.** `inRowUnit` (`admin-import-users.ts:837-858`) runs the write and `joinCurrentOrganization` inside `join.seam.runAtomically`, and rethrows a `CreationRefused` as the row's error with the vendor's code. The header (`:159-165`) records that the password and the invitation come only after the unit commits.
- **Upsert.** `updateData` (`:1000-1016`) runs the profile patch and the join in one `inRowUnit('existing', …)`.
- **Pins.** The multi-org describe of `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts` (`:970` onward) carries a case for every bullet: created rows join, a refused join creates no account or invitation, `400` with and without a dry run, `501`, a dry run joins nothing, both upsert cases, and the single-org / degraded-wall control. Dogfood I1 and I2 exist as named.
- **Form.** It is add-only under the D3 amendment, in the record's own dated `Amendment note` form, with one appended `Amended` entry on the status line, as the 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-11 amendments did. The ruled 2026-10-24 sentence is untouched, and the note says exactly where it no longer holds (bulk import) and where it stands (reconciler, self sign-up, SSO JIT, host hooks). "Walled posture" and "a degraded wall" are the amendment's own terms for `tenancy.isolationActive`. That is the seat's ruling on form.
- **Shape.** `Fixes #34809`, Clause-② `no` and Metadata-protocol `none`. `skip-changeset` is right for `docs/adr/**`, and the README index is unchanged and current. The body states each fact FROM → TO with where it is read and its pin.
- **CI on this sha.** 49 runs: 26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed. Mergeable: clean.

#### Notes (for the seat's L2 and the approver)
- N1: ruling record 6942842013 says the sentence "is rewritten by the implementing PR". This PR keeps the sentence and adds a note, as the claim and the seat chose. The difference from the ruling's letter is the approver's to accept, and the body says so.
- N2: the upsert consequence. A CSV row matched to an existing user joins that user to the administrator's current organization "whichever other organizations that user already belongs to". The unit cases pin the join mechanics, but the cross-organization reach (a match across the deployment, with membership asked of the current organization only) is a reading of the code, not a pin. The contract review of #34750 (6946273468) flagged it for the approver too.
- N3: open PR #34909 appends its own `Amended` entry to the same status line, a one-line text conflict. Whichever lands second merges main and keeps both entries.
- N4: the ruled sentence and D3/D7 differ on SSO JIT and host hooks (the sentence says they bind nothing in multi mode; D7 says those flows own membership). This is the body's observation only, rightly left untouched here.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1a6abb30ddcf659a7b7f4dca23115384bbcd4a6d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md + none
Security-touching: yes

The one file of the diff is the `hits` file; no implementing file is in the diff. Read in the cited code at `origin/main` `4443014630`, not reviewed: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`, `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts`, `docs/adr/0119-plugin-reachable-transactions-and-honest-atomic-batch.md`, and the two test files the note names. `36af6b05a7` is an ancestor of `origin/main`, and `git diff --stat 36af6b05a7 origin/main` over those source files is empty, so the merge and `main` are the same code.

Security-touching is `yes` because the note records who becomes a member of which organization, and under this record's D8 amendment a current membership is what data access rests on. No access finding: the note describes landed behaviour and changes none.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept set and no public surface moves.** Right. The diff is one ADR, +34 / −1; no package, schema, export or generated file is touched.
- **The −1 line is the status line, with one `Amended` entry appended.** Right. The three earlier entries are byte-for-byte kept, and the new entry follows the form of the 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-11 entries. It says "under a walled posture", which matches the predicate the code reads (`tenancy.isolationActive === true`, `admin-user-endpoints.ts:1101-1105`).
- **The ruled 2026-10-24 sentence (head lines 272–274) is untouched.** Right as a reading of the diff: the note is inserted after it and before `### D4`.
- **Citations resolve.** Ruling 6942842013 is on #34535 and reads `Ruled: B`. `36af6b05a7` is the merge of PR #34750. The ADR-0119 link target exists. `Check Documentation Links` and `Lint · docs & code guards` (which carries the ADR anchor gates) concluded success on this head.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

No changeset, `skip-changeset` label. That matches what the diff publishes, which is nothing: one file under `docs/adr/`. `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_question 1, status-line overlap with open PR #34909.** Not re-raised, per the brief: whoever lands second keeps both entries.
- **open_question 2, the ruling says the D3 sentence "is rewritten by the implementing PR"; this PR adds a dated note and leaves the sentence.** Answered on consistency, escalated on form. The note sits directly under the sentence and its second sentence reads "The sentence above no longer holds for bulk import", so no reader meets the stale sentence without its correction, and the record's own D8.1 precedent (keep the ruled text, add a dated note) is followed. What stays the approver's: accepting the note form in place of the ruling's letter. If the approver wants the letter, the card's drafted rewrite of the sentence is the alternative.
- **open_question 3, PR-body trailer and declaration-line spelling.** Outside the `hits` file; `PR-body guards` concluded success on this head. Nothing to judge here.
- **Dev flag, the upsert consequence is read from code and has no pin.** Verified, and the note words it accurately:
  - The match is deployment-wide. The import's `findData` runs `engine.find(args.object, { where, limit, context: SYSTEM_CTX })` on `sys_user` with only the match-key filter (`admin-import-users.ts:919-929`).
  - A matched row always reaches the join. `updateData` calls `inRowUnit('existing', …)` whether or not the patch is empty (`admin-import-users.ts:1004-1016`), and `inRowUnit` runs the write and `joinCurrentOrganization` inside `join.seam.runAtomically` (`admin-import-users.ts:837-857`).
  - The membership probe asks about the current organization only: `where: { organization_id: organizationId, user_id: userId }, limit: 1` (`admin-user-endpoints.ts:1003-1013`). A membership in any other organization is never read, so `addMember({ body: { userId, role: 'member', organizationId } })` runs (`admin-user-endpoints.ts:1015`).
  - So "joins that user too …, whichever other organizations that user already belongs to" is what the code does, and "A user already in the current organization is not added twice" is the probe's early return.
  - The pin gap is real: the upsert case at `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts:1097` seeds `u-out` with no membership anywhere, so no test holds a user of another organization. The note's bullet does not claim a pin for it. The consequence stays the approver's to confirm or strike, as contract review 6946273468 already asked.
- **Dev flag, the ADR-0119 D1 limit is named.** Accurate. The wired seam's `runAtomically` calls `engine.transaction` and falls through to a plain call when the engine has none (`auth-plugin.ts:4847-4853`); ADR-0119 D1 declares that the default driver without `beginTransaction` runs the callback with no rollback.
- **SQL push-down.** No code in the diff: no id materialisation, no in-app join.
- **Check-runs on this head.** 49 runs, all completed. None concluded failure. Success: Lint & Repo Gates and the Lint families, TypeScript Type Check and the Type Check families, Test Core, Test UI, the Dogfood Regression Gate aggregate, Check Documentation Links, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, filter. The rest are skipped by the path selector, which is expected for a docs-only diff.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Each sentence of the note, read against the code:

- **"Under a walled posture … follows this amendment's rule row by row, through the one settlement and the one join Create User runs."** Holds. `runAdminImportUsers` calls `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` (`admin-import-users.ts:827`) and `joinCurrentOrganization` (`:846`), the same two functions `runAdminCreateUser` calls (`admin-user-endpoints.ts:793`, `:873`). The settlement does not read `membershipPolicy`, so the amendment's `invite-only` bullet carries over as "this amendment's rule" implies.
- **"Settled once, before any row is written, on a dry run too."** Holds. The settlement runs before `runImport` with no `dryRun` branch ahead of it (`:827-829`, `runImport` at `:1020`). `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION` and `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` are the settlement's own two answers (`admin-user-endpoints.ts:1060-1088`); `501` is `!deps.createGrant` or no `addMember` function, as the note says.
- **"A dry run that is not refused joins nothing."** Holds. On `dryRun` the row engine takes its verdict branch and calls neither `createData` nor `updateData` (`import-runner.ts:1630`), so `inRowUnit` never runs.
- **"One unit of work per created row … as `member` through better-auth's `addMember` … A refused join … fails with the vendor's code, is handed no temporary password and is sent no invitation. The other rows go on."** Holds. `createData` wraps `authApi.createUser` in `inRowUnit('created', …)` (`:967-979`); the password and the invitation target are recorded only after the unit returns (`:981-993`); `CreationRefused` is rethrown as the row's error with the refusal's `code` (`:850-856`).
- **Upsert bullet.** Holds, see ③. The import accepts only `insert` and `upsert` (`:705`), so "(upsert)" names every mode that can match.
- **"Single mode (a degraded wall included) is unchanged."** Holds. The predicate answers false, the settlement answers `undefined`, and `inRowUnit` calls the write directly (`:842`).
- **Pins.** The named cases exist: the multi-org describe at `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts:970-1143` and I1, I2 at `create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts:149`, `:175`.

Internal consistency of the record after the note. I read every sentence of the head that mentions import or multi-mode binding (TL;DR, Context, D1, D2 coverage, the D3 table, D7, D8.4, the D8 amendment's consequences, Rollout phase 2). The one live sentence the note contradicts is the 2026-10-24 closing sentence, and the note says so in its second sentence. D2's coverage line and Rollout phase 2 are about the reconciler, which still binds import-created users in single mode and nothing in multi mode. The D3 table's `multi` row is the reconciler's target. None of these is contradicted. I tried to break it on the `invite-only` policy, on the no-patch upsert row, on the order of the two whole-request refusals (the note claims no order), and on the degraded wall. None broke.

- N1 (nit) — the note's last opening sentence says, in its own 2026-11-17 voice, that self sign-up, SSO JIT and host hooks "still bind nothing in multi mode". Read literally, that disagrees with the D3 table ("invite / JIT / host hooks own membership") and D7's SSO JIT row. The disagreement is the 2026-10-24 sentence's, which means the reconciler binds nothing for users arriving by those paths; the note repeats it and adds no new claim, so the contract does not move. A wording that only says the sentence is unchanged for those paths would avoid restating it. Left for the approver, or a follow-up.
- N2 (nit) — D8.4 still lists "actor-active-org inheritance" among what the framework leaves to other flows in multi mode, while Create User (since 2026-10-24) and now bulk import do exactly that. Pre-existing since the 2026-10-24 amendment and not introduced by this note; the note extends it to a second door. A follow-up could annotate D8.4.
- N3 (nit) — the note covers two of the settlement's three "joins nothing" cells. The third: a host that calls `runAdminImportUsers` without a current-organization reader joins nothing and is not refused, even under a walled posture (`admin-user-endpoints.ts:1101-1105`). The shipped route always wires the reader (`auth-plugin.ts:5189-5196`), so no shipped deployment reaches it; the Create User amendment omits it too.
- N4 (nit) — the closing "Pinned by the multi-org cases of …" sentence stands under all four bullets, and one clause of the upsert bullet (a user of another organization) has no pin. The bullet itself claims none. Left as written, with the gap stated in ③ for the approver.
